purpose: Consolidate demonstrated AI/project-operation failure patterns as eval evidence; failures are not requirements by themselves.

families.name: State and continuity loss
families.failure: Material state, evidence or next-action context is unavailable or incomplete across session/environment changes.
families.open_gap: Materiality detection and true fresh-context availability are not fully demonstrated end-to-end.

families.name: Systemic drift and local optimization
families.failure: A locally coherent change grows or passes assurance while related project state becomes stale.

evidence.kind: stale global state after local green change

families.open_gap: Impact discovery and long-horizon scope growth remain judgement-heavy.

families.name: Authority and promotion creep
families.failure: AI, CI, silence, enthusiasm or implementation is treated as authority it does not own.
families.open_gap: Natural-language inference of acceptance remains model-dependent.

families.name: Epistemic integrity loss
families.failure: Uncertainty, provenance, alternatives or unresolved relations are flattened, invented or laundered.
families.open_gap: Compression and reprocessing fidelity need perturbation tests.

families.name: Premature solutioning and over-modeling
families.failure: Technology, abstraction or governance is introduced before demonstrated need and fit.
families.open_gap: Plausible compensating structures can accumulate over many small steps.

families.name: False assurance and overclaiming
families.failure: Evidence is described more strongly than it supports.
families.open_gap: Natural-language claims need evidence-calibrated regression grading.

families.name: Execution and progress pathologies
families.failure: The system chooses costly routes, repeats passed prerequisites, loops without delta or asks the owner to courier derivable context.
families.open_gap: Progress-delta, invalidation and terse free-text intent reconstruction lack executable regressions.
